description: Lay the Phase-2 test foundation and remove the BOM duplication. Add the model factories later features need, extract one shared ConditionEvaluator (Q-1), unify BOM generation on BomGeneratorService and DELETE the inferior BomService (A-1). This leaves a single BOM path and a single condition evaluator for everything downstream to build on. Independent of FEAT-002+ except that it must land first (prerequisite).
steps: Add factories in database/factories/ mirroring the Phase 0 style (fake() helper, '@extends Factory<Model>', '@return array<string, mixed>', state methods): ComponentFactory (+ ComponentCategoryFactory if missing), ConfigurationRuleFactory, RuleConditionFactory, RuleActionFactory, BomRuleFactory, BomRuleConditionFactory, BomRuleItemFactory, CompatibilityRuleFactory, PriceListFactory, ProductPriceFactory, OptionPriceFactory, PartNumberPatternFactory. For pivot ProductAttribute, prefer attaching via Product::attributes()->attach(id, [...pivot...]) in tests rather than a pivot factory. Give models that lack 'use HasFactory;' but now need a factory the trait: Component, ConfigurationRule, RuleCondition, RuleAction, BomRule, BomRuleCondition, BomRuleItem, CompatibilityRule, PriceList, ProductPrice, OptionPrice, PartNumberPattern. Rule/bom factories must set a unique 'code' to satisfy the unique index.

Create app/Services/Rules/ConditionEvaluator.php with one typed public method, e.g. 'public function passes(iterable $conditions, string $ruleLogic, array $selections): bool'. Replicate current semantics EXACTLY (see context.json key_patterns): group by 'group' column; within a group use conditions->first()->logic (OR=>in_array(true), else !in_array(false)); across groups use $ruleLogic (OR=>in_array(true), else !in_array(false)); empty conditions => true; actual = $selections[$condition->attribute_id] ?? null; RuleOperator::from($condition->operator)->evaluate($actual, $condition->value). Add PHPDoc.

Refactor RuleEngineService to inject ConditionEvaluator (constructor property promotion) and replace its private evaluateConditions()/evaluateConditionGroup() with a call to the evaluator (pass $rule->conditions, $rule->condition_logic, $selections).
Refactor BomGeneratorService to inject ConditionEvaluator and replace its private conditionsMet() with the evaluator (pass $rule->conditions, $rule->condition_logic, $selections).

In ConfiguratorService replace the 'private readonly BomService $bom' constructor dependency with 'private readonly BomGeneratorService $bom' and keep the ->generate($product, $selections) call (same signature). Verify ProductConfigurator::saveConfiguration() still works: it reads $item['component_id','quantity','unit_price','is_mandatory'] — all present in the rich BOM shape.
Grep every reference to App\Services\Bom\BomService across app/ and update/remove; then delete app/Services/Bom/BomService.php. Confirm no caller remains.

Add tests/Unit/ConditionEvaluatorTest.php (Pest) covering AND-within-group, OR-within-group, OR-across-groups, empty=>true. Add tests/Feature/BomParityTest.php (Pest): build a Product with a BOM rule whose conditions match a selection; assert the save path BOM (ConfiguratorService::evaluate()->bom) equals the generate path (WorkspaceController::generateBom -> session->bom_snapshot) for the same selections — same component ids, quantities, and keys. Run Pint and the targeted tests.
acceptance_criteria: app/Services/Bom/BomService.php no longer exists and no file under app/ references App\Services\Bom\BomService.

ConfiguratorService, RuleEngineService, and BomGeneratorService all use BomGeneratorService/ConditionEvaluator; no duplicated condition-evaluation code remains in RuleEngineService or BomGeneratorService.
The save-path BOM and the generate/export-path BOM produce identical rows for identical selections (BomParityTest passes).
All listed factories instantiate and ->create() successfully.
The base 20 tests plus the new ConditionEvaluator and BomParity tests pass.
findings:
DONE. Full suite green: 25 passed (20 base + ConditionEvaluatorTest 4 + BomParityTest 1).

=== ConditionEvaluator (app/Services/Rules/ConditionEvaluator.php) ===
Single public method signature: `public function passes(iterable $conditions, string $ruleLogic, array $selections): bool`. It does `collect($conditions)->groupBy('group')`, so pass any iterable of objects exposing attribute_id/operator/value/logic/group (Eloquent collection of RuleCondition/BomRuleCondition works directly). Semantics replicated exactly: empty => true; within-group logic from first condition's `logic` (OR => in_array(true), else !in_array(false)); across-group logic from $ruleLogic same way. RuleEngineService and BomGeneratorService both inject it via constructor property promotion (private readonly ConditionEvaluator $conditionEvaluator) and call ->passes($rule->conditions, $rule->condition_logic, $selections). The old private evaluateConditions()/evaluateConditionGroup()/conditionsMet() are GONE.

=== BOM unified ===
app/Services/Bom/BomService.php DELETED. ConfiguratorService now depends on `private readonly BomGeneratorService $bom` and still calls ->generate($product, $selections). No file under app/ references App\Services\Bom\BomService. BomGeneratorService::generate() returns the RICH BOM shape (array_values, numeric component_id keys collapsed). Confirmed BOM row shape (keys): item_no, component_id, part_number, sales_part_number, description, long_description, type, manufacturer, manufacturer_part_no, quantity (float), unit ('EA'), unit_price (float), cost (float), total_price (float), currency, is_mandatory (bool), lead_time (null), remarks (null). ProductConfigurator::saveConfiguration reads component_id/quantity/unit_price/is_mandatory from this shape - all present.

=== Factories added (database/factories/) ===
ComponentFactory, ComponentCategoryFactory, ConfigurationRuleFactory (+orLogic() state, unique code 'CR-'+random), RuleConditionFactory (default operator=equals, value numeric string, group 0, logic AND), RuleActionFactory (action_type='show', target_type='attribute'), BomRuleFactory (+orLogic() state, unique code 'BR-'+random), BomRuleConditionFactory, BomRuleItemFactory (quantity float, is_mandatory true), CompatibilityRuleFactory (type='incompatible'), PriceListFactory (+default() state), ProductPriceFactory, OptionPriceFactory, PartNumberPatternFactory (segments=[{type:literal,value:HEC,separator:-}]). HasFactory trait added to: Component, ComponentCategory, ConfigurationRule, RuleCondition, RuleAction, BomRule, BomRuleCondition, BomRuleItem, CompatibilityRule, PriceList, ProductPrice, OptionPrice, PartNumberPattern.
ComponentFactory nests ComponentCategory::factory(). Rule/BOM condition+item factories nest their parent rule + Attribute/Component factories, so ->create() works standalone.
For pivot ProductAttribute use Product::attributes()->attach($attributeId, ['is_required'=>..,'is_visible'=>..,'sort_order'=>..]) in tests (no pivot factory). Attribute+AttributeOption factories are Phase 0; AttributeFactory->withOptions(n) exists.

=== Tests ===
tests/Unit/ConditionEvaluatorTest.php uses a makeCondition() helper building (object) casts (no DB). tests/Feature/BomParityTest.php seeds RolesAndPermissionsSeeder, builds product+attribute+option+component+BomRule(+condition+item), compares ConfiguratorService::evaluate()->bom against the controller route sales.configuration.generate-bom -> session->bom_snapshot via toEqual (identical). generate-bom route is POST, bound by ConfigurationSession id, behind auth + ConfigurationSessionPolicy view (engineering role is internal, bypasses ownership).
